hack.root_cause: Compromised Private Key — Multi-chain LP Drain + Token Mint
hack.description: Dego Finance lost ~$10M across three chains when a compromised private key gave attackers admin access to LP tokens and the DEGO token mint function, with no multi-sig protecting any of it.
